title: Home staffing and school membership stay active
openingNarrative: Medical instability may move dates. It does not erase legal orders, educational membership, or privacy rights. The team must keep one continuity decision live: protect two-person paid home airway staffing plans, or protect staged school return planning with trained paid responders. Family and friends stay outside the clinical roster. Rohan co-owns the framing. Public emergency footage from the library event is not automatically training content.
clinicalState: Still ICU. Airway and infection courses ongoing. Communication access partially restored. Home readiness and school access domains remain trackable mid-ICU. Authorship and privacy live alongside physiology.

choices.label: Lock the two-person paid home airway-responder plan as non-negotiable on discharge planning
choices.immediateConsequence: Home readiness and public trust rise. Family burden falls because the plan rejects parent-as-second-responder funding logic. School timeline may slip without deleting membership.
choices.delayedConsequence: Insurers may push telemetry or video ‘for safety’; privacy protection must stay explicit. Next episode can test relief staffing coverage.
choices.rohanAacLine: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

choices.label: Keep staged school membership active with two trained responders in the plan
choices.immediateConsequence: School access holds. Appropriate emergency transfer remains part of support—not proof inclusion failed. Home staffing still needs separate paid coverage.
choices.delayedConsequence: School may argue instability proves exclusion; counter-principle stays: transfer can be the plan working. Authorship needed if any training package uses this episode.

choices.label: Refuse continuous video/GPS ‘comfort monitoring’ and require Rohan’s consent for any story use
choices.immediateConsequence: Privacy and authorship rise sharply. Some clinicians feel less ‘covered’; family fear may spike without becoming a reason to seize Rohan’s body as the treatment site for trauma.
choices.delayedConsequence: Home Evidence Trust principles apply: least intrusive evidence; AAC logs protected; raw conversations not routine evidence. Next episode can reopen proportionate monitoring debates.

disabilityRightsNotes: Clinical response labour stays with paid staff. Family and friends remain support people by choice, not substitute clinicians.
School emergency transfer can be part of inclusion, not evidence against it.
Rohan’s identity, voice, and authored framing require consent.
Instability changes dates; it does not auto-erase rights.
debriefNotes: Home and school rights remain active mid-ICU—core acceptance criterion.
Privacy versus fear is a live trade-off without vilifying Samira.
Hook into debrief: rights domains are scored alongside physiology.
